backupCard.title: Backup folder
backupCard.intro: Hearth writes a snapshot of everything to a folder you choose — on a USB stick, or a folder that Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or similar keeps in sync — after every change, and can load it back on another computer. Nothing is sent by Hearth itself.
backupCard.storeUnencrypted: Store unencrypted (plaintext genetic data in the folder)
backupCard.reconnectNotice: The browser needs your permission again to use this folder.
backupCard.needsPassphrase: Enter the passphrase (or tick unencrypted) to resume backups.
backupCard.conflict: Another computer saved a newer backup to this folder since you last loaded it. Yours was written as {file} instead. Load theirs first, or keep yours and overwrite.
backupCard.newerNotice: The folder holds a backup from another computer that is newer than what is here.
backupCard.missingGenomes: No backup in {name} still has the genome files for {names}, including older copies and conflict files. Import their raw files again from their person pages; the next backup will include them.
backupCard.loaded: Loaded {people} new people and {genomes} genomes from {name} ({exportedAt}).
backupCard.forgetConfirm: Also delete the backup files in the folder? (Cancel keeps them.)
backupCard.introManual: This browser cannot keep a folder in sync, so backups are files. Back up builds an encrypted snapshot and opens the share sheet, where you choose Google Drive, Files or any other app. On another device, Load backup opens a saved file and adds what is in it. Nothing is sent by Hearth itself.
backupCard.downloadOnly: This browser can only download the file. Upload it to Google Drive from the Drive app, or move it somewhere safe.
backupCard.neverShared: No backup from this device yet.
backupCard.changedSince: Changes since then are not in it.
backupCard.needsPassphraseManual: Enter a passphrase (or tick unencrypted) to back up.
backupCard.fileReady: {name} is ready. Tap Share to save it.
backupCard.shared: Backup handed to the app you chose. Check that it arrived.
backupCard.downloaded: Backup downloaded. Move it to Google Drive or another safe place.
